records.question: Show April 2026 revision summary by project and team leader

report.title: April 2026 Revision Summary by Project and Team Leader
report.sql:
SELECT p.project_name, u.name AS team_leader, COUNT(cm.id) AS revision_count, COALESCE(SUM(cm.changerequest_detailing_estimated_hrs), 0) AS total_estimated_detailing_hrs, COALESCE(SUM(cm.changerequest_checking_estimated_hrs), 0) AS total_estimated_checking_hrs FROM changerequest_management cm JOIN projects p ON cm.project_id = p.id JOIN users u ON cm.changerequest_assign_to = u.id WHERE cm.date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' AND cm.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.project_name, u.name ORDER BY p.project_name, u.name
LIMIT 500
report.explanation: This query retrieves a summary of change requests (revisions) for April 2026, grouped by project name and team leader. It counts the number of revisions and sums the estimated detailing and checking hours for each project-team leader combination. The query joins changerequest_management with projects to get project names and with users to get team leader names based on the changerequest_assign_to field. The date filter uses the literal dates '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30' as specified, and excludes deleted records.
assumptions: Interpreted the requested period as April 2026.
The changerequest_assign_to field in changerequest_management contains the user ID of the team leader responsible for the revision
Revisions are tracked as change request records in the changerequest_management table
The date field in changerequest_management represents when the revision was created or logged
Project names are stored in the projects table and team leader names in the users table
